module.title: Security: IP Check
module.description:
## IP Reputation Check
Checks a client IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) against known blocklists (Spamhaus SBL/XBL/PBL/EHN, Barracuda BRBL, SpamCop SCBL, Abusix Mail Intelligence, Invaluement, Sorbs DNSBL [deprecated], Bogon ranges) and returns a reputation-based result.
Each blocklist can be individually enabled or disabled via the `use.list.*` configuration flags.
**API endpoint:** `api/ipcheck/check`
### Usage
``` GET /api/ipcheck/check?ip=1.2.3.4 GET /api/ipcheck/check?ip=2001:db8::1 ```
### Response
```json { "status": "data", "data": { "ip": "1.2.3.4", "ip_version": 4, "clean": false, "score": -50, "sources": { "spamhaus_sbl": { "listed": false, "description": "Spamhaus SBL" }, "bogons": { "listed": true, "description": "Bogon addresses" } } } } ```
### Configuration
- `active` — Module main switch (boolean) - `cache_ttl` — DNS lookup cache TTL in seconds (default: 3600) - `use.list.bogons` — Enable bogon range check (default: yes) - `use.list.spamhaus_sbl` — Enable Spamhaus SBL check (default: yes) - `use.list.spamhaus_xbl` — Enable Spamhaus XBL check (default: yes) - `use.list.spamhaus_pbl` — Enable Spamhaus PBL check (default: yes) - `use.list.spamhaus_ehn` — Enable Spamhaus EHN check (default: yes) - `use.list.sorbs` — Enable Sorbs DNSBL check (default: yes, deprecated) - `use.list.barracuda` — Enable Barracuda BRBL check (default: yes) - `use.list.spamcop` — Enable SpamCop SCBL check (default: yes) - `use.list.abusix` — Enable Abusix Mail Intelligence check (default: yes) - `use.list.invaluement` — Enable Invaluement DNSBL check (default: yes) - `skip_local_ips` — Skip all checks for local/private IPs (for local development, default: no) - `log.rejected` — Log rejected IPs to database (default: yes) - `log.post_data` — Include POST data in rejected IP logs (default: yes) - `log.headers` — Include request headers in rejected IP logs (default: yes) - `log.retention.days` — Delete log entries older than N days (default: 90)
module.log: Initial release — IP reputation check against Spamhaus and bogon lists.
Add IPv6 support. Make each blocklist individually toggleable via config.
Moved to Security/IP/Check. Renamed classes from IPReputation to IpCheck.
Added Barracuda BRBL, SpamCop SCBL, Abusix, and Invaluement DNSBLs. Marked Sorbs as deprecated.
Replaced sequential gethostbyname() with parallel curl_multi DNS-over-HTTPS via Cloudflare 1.1.1.1.
Added skip_local_ips config flag for local development. Bogon check now detects IP spoofing for all IPs.
Added database logging for rejected requests (log_api_rejects table). Configurable POST data and header logging.
Added admin interface for viewing, filtering, exporting, and deleting rejected IP log entries.
Moved install SQL into module definition. Renamed table columns from snake_case to camelCase.
Add data entities for check query, source and result.
